_comment: Traducciones al inglés de las cadenas de Susurro. La clave es el texto fuente en español tal como aparece en el código; el valor es el inglés. Tools/localize.py las aplica sobre Localizable.xcstrings después de que Xcode extrae las claves del código — extraer primero es lo que garantiza que los marcadores de formato (%@, %lld) queden exactamente como Swift los genera, que escritos a mano se equivocan siempre.
Accesibilidad hace falta para dos cosas:: Accessibility is needed for two things: hearing the key while you're in another app, and pasting the text where your cursor is. Without it Susurro still transcribes, but leaves the text on the clipboard.
Además arma párrafos o listas cuando el: Also breaks text into paragraphs or lists when the dictation calls for it.
Cambiaste de app mientras se transcribía: You switched apps while it was transcribing. The text is on the clipboard — paste it with ⌘V.
Cero descarga: usa el motor que ya trae: No download: uses the engine macOS already ships. Good for trying the app right away.
Corrige puntuación y mayúsculas y saca m: Fixes punctuation and capitalization and removes filler words, without touching what you said.
Dos toques rápidos dejan el dictado enga: Two quick taps latch dictation on.
El equilibrio recomendado: rápido, preci: The recommended balance: fast, accurate and multilingual.
El mismo modelo con menos peso en disco;: The same model with a smaller footprint; slightly less accurate.
El modelo quedó incompleto. Volvé a desc: The model download is incomplete. Download it again from Settings.
The model hasn't been downloaded yet.
El más liviano y el más rápido, si dictá: The smallest and fastest, if you dictate only in English.
El recomendado. Es el que limpia bien el: The recommended one. It cleans Spanish properly without drifting into answering you.
El sistema usa 🌐 para cambiar el idioma: The system uses 🌐 to switch input source or show emoji. Set it to "Do Nothing" in Settings › Keyboard to free it up.
Falta el permiso de Accesibilidad. El te: Accessibility permission is missing. The text is on the clipboard — paste it with ⌘V.
Fijar un idioma mejora un poco la precis: Pinning a language improves accuracy slightly. Leave it on automatic if you mix languages when you speak.
Hace que los dictados encadenados arranq: Makes back-to-back dictations start instantly, but keeps the orange microphone dot lit and degrades audio quality on Bluetooth headphones.
Hay un campo de contraseña activo. El te: A password field is active. The text is on the clipboard — paste it with ⌘V.
Inserta la transcripción tal cual. La la: Inserts the transcript as-is. The lowest possible latency.
Mantenela apretada mientras hablás y sol: Hold it down while you speak and release to insert the text. Two quick taps latch dictation on until you press it again. Esc cancels.
Hold it down while you speak, then release.
Mantener el micrófono listo entre dictad: Keep the microphone ready between dictations
Mantené una tecla, hablá, soltá. El text: Hold a key, speak, release. The text appears wherever your cursor is.
Más liviano y más rápido, pero limpia ba: Lighter and faster, but cleans up noticeably less. Better in English than in Spanish.
No se pudo pegar en esta app. El texto q: Couldn't paste into this app. The text is on the clipboard — paste it with ⌘V.
Ojo: en el teclado estadounidense, Opció: Heads up: on the US keyboard layout, Option is the accent key (⌥+e gives "é"). Susurro steps aside as soon as it sees the second key, but if you write a lot in Spanish, pick another one.
Para idiomas que Parakeet no cubre. Más: For languages Parakeet doesn't cover. Slower, and it can invent text over silence.
Parakeet corre en el Neural Engine: es m: Parakeet runs on the Neural Engine: faster than Whisper, more accurate in Spanish, and it leaves the GPU free for cleanup. Whisper is there for the languages Parakeet doesn't cover.
Podés comprobarlo: desconectá el wifi de: You can verify it: turn off Wi-Fi after downloading the model and keep dictating.
Si el modelo tarda más de un segundo y m: If the model takes longer than a second and a half, or returns something that doesn't resemble what you dictated, Susurro discards the cleanup and inserts the raw transcript. You will never get the model's answer instead of your text.
Si ya lo activaste y sigue en rojo, hay: If you've already enabled it and it's still red, Susurro has to restart for macOS to pick it up.
Es para escuchar lo que dictás. El audio: It's to hear what you dictate. The audio is processed right here and discarded as soon as it's transcribed: nothing is stored, nothing is sent anywhere.
Hace falta para dos cosas: escuchar la t: It's needed for two things: hearing the dictation key even while you're typing in another app, and pasting the text where your cursor is. Susurro does not read what you type or what's on your screen.
Susurro transcribe lo que dictás usando: Susurro transcribes what you dictate using models that run on your Mac. The audio never leaves the device: no server, no account, no history. The only time Susurro uses the network is to download a model, and always because you asked it to.
Todo pasa en tu Mac. El audio no sale de: Everything happens on your Mac. The audio never leaves: no server, no account, nothing stored.

macOS tiene bloqueado el acceso de Susur: macOS is blocking Susurro's access to the clipboard, so it can't be restored. You can change that in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Paste from Other Apps.

_comment_formato: Las que siguen llevan interpolación. Los marcadores %@ y %lld tienen que coincidir en cantidad y orden con los del español, o Xcode marca el catálogo como inconsistente.
%@ necesita una versión más nueva de mac: %@ needs a newer version of macOS.
%@ tiene activada la entrada segura. El: %@ has secure input enabled. The text is on the clipboard — paste it with ⌘V.
Empezás con %@. En Ajustes podés cambiar: You're starting with %@. You can switch to a more accurate model in Settings whenever you like.
macOS needs you to approve it.
Falta grabar el atajo. Hacé clic en el r: No shortcut recorded yet. Click the field and press your key combination.
Ojo: ese atajo es el de «%@» en todas la: Heads up: that shortcut means "%@" in every macOS app. If you use it to dictate, it stops working everywhere else.
